topics.description: Multiple election fraud investigations are underway in various states, including California and Minnesota. These investigations are focused on alleged voting irregularities and potential fraud in the electoral process.
topics.reason: Recent claims of election fraud have led to a surge in investigations across the country.

topics.description: Medicaid fraud continues to be a significant concern, with millions of dollars in fraudulent claims being uncovered. Recent cases include a $250M scheme in Minnesota.
topics.reason: The large sums of money involved in Medicaid make it a prime target for fraudulent activity.
